notes.title: 🌟 Demo 3.0 Update Notes 🌟
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!
It’s been 2 months since our last update, and we’re excited to share that [b]Demo 3.0 is now live![/b] 🎉
This will be the [b]final demo update[/b] before the full release — thank you so much for your support and feedback so far![/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 Changes & Updates[/h3][list][*][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b] – many issues reported by players have been resolved[/p][/*][*][p]🃏 [b]New Deck[/b] – discover new ways to play and strategies to try[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]New Difficulty System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clear [b]Easy Mode[/b] to unlock new treasures[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge yourself in [b]Hard Mode[/b] for tougher gameplay[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]UI & Art Polish[/b] – smoother visuals and interface improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]💡 What’s Next[/h3][p]This is our last demo before the full release. We’ll keep polishing, balancing, and adding content to make sure the final version delivers the best experience possible.[/p][p]Thank you again for playing our game and sharing your feedback — it really means a lot to our tiny team! 💖[/p][p]👉 If you haven’t already, give [b]Demo 3.0[/b] a try on Steam![/p]

notes.title: Demo V2.0 Now Available! Try It Free!
notes.content:
[b]🧧 Demo Update – V2.0 is Live! 🀄[/b]

Hey everyone! We’ve just released V2.0 of the demo with big improvements and fresh content, based on your feedback. Here's what’s new:

[b]🀄 Visual & UI Improvements[/b]

Visual update for a cleaner and more polished look

UI/UX refinements to improve flow and clarity

[b]🀄Gameplay & System Updates[/b]

Save / Load system added – you can now resume your journey!

Traditional Chinese language support added 🇹🇼

Enemy selection now comes with reward previews

ANG PAO system removed for better balance

[b]🀄 Card & Treasure Tweaks[/b]

Multiple treasure bugs fixed

More new skill cards added to spice up your strategy

General bug fixes for smoother gameplay
